acceptance_notes.coefficient_warning: EKF coefficient estimates are model states/outputs, not direct measurements.
acceptance_notes.expected_manual_qc: Run plot_straight_vwt_harvest_qc.py and inspect the retained intervals before using these cases for dissertation plots.

column_definitions.CD_kcu_ekf/CD_bridles_ekf/CD_tether_ekf: Parasitic drag coefficients exported by EKF-AWE, nondimensionalized with kite reference area.
column_definitions.CL_ekf/CD_ekf/L_over_D_ekf: EKF state/model estimates; not direct aerodynamic force-balance measurements. These are wing-level coefficients.
column_definitions.CL_kite_ekf/CD_kite_ekf/L_over_D_kite_ek: Kite-level validation coefficients. CL_kite_ekf is the exported wing lift coefficient; CD_kite_ekf adds exported KCU and bridle parasitic drag coefficients to CD_ekf. Tether drag is exported separately as CD_tether_ekf and is not included.
column_definitions.preferred_tether_force_N: First positive finite force source in the campaign force-source priority list.
column_definitions.u_dp_ch9: Dimensionless dissertation depower convention for Ch. 9.
column_definitions.u_s_ch9: Dimensionless steering, positive/negative signed, near zero for symmetric validation.

depower_conversion_rules.2019: Retain u_p_2019_raw_or_normalized and use Section 9.1 best guess u_dp_ch9 = 0.2564 - 0.0768 u_p_2019. depower_tape_length_m = 0.2 + 5 u_dp_ch9.
depower_conversion_rules.2025: Use documented 2025 convention. If kcu_actual_depower is stored as percent, u_dp_ch9 = kcu_actual_depower / 100. depower_tape_length_m = 0.2 + 5 u_dp_ch9.

warnings: 2019: u_dp_ch9 uses the approximate Section 9.1 conversion u_dp = 0.2564 - 0.0768 u_p_2019; treat 2019 geometry validation as trend-only.
